tools.name: search_plans
tools.description: Find travel eSIM data plans for a destination from every provider esimdata tracks, ranked neutrally by price (or price per GB, or validity). Filter by trip length, data, unlimited, needs (hotspot, 5G, phone number, top-up, no ID check) and budget. Each result has a buy_url to the provider's page and

tools.name: get_plan
tools.description: Everything esimdata knows about one plan (by the id search_plans returned): all countries it covers, networks, policies, the provider's own page, the buy link and its price history.

tools.name: compare_plans
tools.description: Put 2 to 10 plans (ids from search_plans) side by side with the same fields, in the order given, to help a traveller choose.

tools.name: country_overview
tools.description: A destination at a glance: how many plans and providers, the cheapest plan, the cheapest per GB, and which mobile networks the providers say they use there.

tools.name: check_phone
tools.description: Check whether a phone, tablet or watch model supports eSIM, from the manufacturer's own published list (with regional exceptions, e.g. models sold in mainland China), with the source link.

tools.name: list_providers
tools.description: Every eSIM provider esimdata compares, with its website and whether esimdata earns a commission when a traveller buys through it (ranking never depends on it).
